notes.title: Changelog 1.04
notes.notes:
[b]Controls & Input:
[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where players could bind the same key to two different actions.
[*] Added a shake effect to indicate when a control button is already assigned to another action.
[*] Added a scroll bar to menu options.
[/list]

[b]Animations:
[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved sitting animations.
[*] Improved reversal animations.
[*] Tweaked the distance of reversal attacks before they connect to avoid clipping.
[*] Fixed issue when interactable icon gets disabled after interacting with prisoner sometimes.
[*] Fixed an issue where Afro hair moved erratically up and down.
[*] While interacting fixed snapped up movement when player is standing still.
[/list]

[b]Audio:
[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where hit sounds wouldn't play during player reversal attacks.
[*] Fixed a bug where the walking sound effect would play twice.
[*] Set a minimum volume for sound effects at startup.
[*] Added a new sound effect for dialogue clicks.
[*] Added missing audio events.
[/list]

[b]Gameplay & AI:
[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an bug when prisoner is knocked out, their status is now correctly updated.
[*] Fixed a bug where the camera would sometimes move sideways when the player was not in combat.
[*] Fixed a bug where prisoners would delay their morning tasks, resulting in lower crowd density in some prison cells during the early morning.
[*] Fixed a bug where the player couldn't drink or eat while performing other actions, such as sitting.
[*] Fixed an issue where [missing verb] while sleeping, brushing teeth, or exercising. 
[*] The inventory can now only be used when the player is in an idle state.
[*] Block mode now correctly consumes stamina.
[*] Successfully blocking a hit now adds stamina.
[*] Added more variety to prisoners.
[/list]

[b]UI/UX:
[/b]
[list]
[*] Dialogue options now appear with a slider to display all available choices.
[*] Dialogue option parameters (e.g., name, crime) are now updated more quickly during conversations.
[*] Changes made in the game options menu are now saved.
[*] Fixed a bug where the inventory was accessible during menu screens or pop-ups.
[/list]
[b]Characters
[/b]
[list]
[*] Added two new hairstyles.
[*] Fixed a bug where player clothes would sometimes not load after startup.
[*] Added: Prisoners now have different skin tones.
[/list]

notes.title: Changelog Version 0.20
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a lighting issue in the outdoor scene. 
[*] Fixed an issue where changing the interact button key binding was not reflected in the main game. 
[*] Added new choking animations.
[*] Fixed an issue with colorful artifacts appearing during game loading. 
[*] Fixed a bug where AI would not move towards the player to attack.
[*] Fixed a bug where AI would slide towards the player after attacking. 
[*] Fixed an issue where the distance between attacks was incorrect.
[*] Fixed an issue where prisoners would walk in guard mode even when no enemies were present. 
[*] Fixed a bug where the game was not correctly detecting whether a prisoner was sitting or sleeping. 
[/list]

notes.title: Changelog Version 0.19
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Improved sleeping animation.
[*] Fixed bug where player repeats the same animation while standing up.
[*] Fixed bug when player goes back to the menu.
[*] Fixed washing hand, teeth brushing, and face washing animation.
[*] Fixed washing basin standing point bug.
[*] Fixed bug where prisoner randomly attacks other prisoners.
[*] Implemented smooth light transition after weather change. 
[*] Implemented smooth fog transition. 
[*] Now prisoners will only play checkers or cards if they have company.
[*] Fixed bug where prisoner stutters when trying to leave prison cell.
[*] Reduced fog intensity in the prison scene.
[*] Game will now start in the early morning.
[*] Fixed bug where audio click didn't work when clicked on dialogues.
[/list]
